question: How many unique sessions visited the /regist/input page and then the /regist/confirm page, in that order?
sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f1.session) as unique_sessions
FROM form_log f1
JOIN form_log f2 ON f1.session = f2.session
WHERE f1.path = '/regist/input'
  AND f2.path = '/regist/confirm'
  AND f2.stamp > f1.stamp
